author: c. m. miller
title: David Livingston posts commentary on jobs and party differences on June 24
text:
David Livingston, a Republican elected to the Arizona State House in 2023 representing the state’s 28th House District, posted a series of statements on his social media account on June 24, 2026.
On June 24, Livingston posted “Good riddance https://t.co/FhmO60mgJU” at 13:28 UTC. Shortly after, at 13:28:51 UTC, he shared another message: “Major difference between Republicans and democrats https://t.co/9p7Mj2ddOx”. At 13:32:04 UTC, Livingston wrote “Jobs, Jobs and more Jobs https://t.co/2WNh2DNbNv”.
Livingston assumed office following his election in 2023, succeeding Kelli Butler as the representative for Arizona’s 28th House District.
